verdict.rationale: The evidence documents automatic per-call token usage and cost tracking, custom model pricing via `add_cost`, and Threads/sessions that group traces. Nothing in the pack shows attaching custom metadata (user IDs, feature tags) to calls, or rolling up cost and usage by user, session, or feature. Per-call costs and session grouping are adjacent features, not the attribution capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
